rows: Tenant isolation on every data query
Two active tenants A and B, each with its own conversations, leads and knowledge modules
Sign in as the tenant B admin and request a record that belongs to tenant A by its identifier
HTTP 404 is returned and no tenant A payload appears in the response body
Executed 2026-08-18. Checked on conversations, leads and knowledge modules; every attempt returned 404 with an empty body.
Permission fence on a protected endpoint
A sale user whose role is not granted the agent.manage permission
Call the agent skill write endpoint with a valid access token
HTTP 403 is returned, the skill store is unchanged and the attempt is written to the audit log
Executed 2026-08-18. Retested after the permission code on the skill endpoints was corrected; the store was unchanged and the audit row was present.
Lead visibility is scoped to the assigned inbox
A sale user who owns inbox 1 only, while leads exist on inbox 1 and inbox 2
Open the lead list page and inspect the returned identifiers
Only leads attached to inbox 1 are returned; the read all permission is required to see the rest
Executed 2026-08-18. A sale user saw 7 of 19 leads; the manager account with the read all permission saw all 19.
Access token expiry and refresh rotation
A signed in session holding one access token and one refresh token
Wait for the access token lifetime to elapse, then call a protected endpoint and refresh once
The expired token is rejected with HTTP 401; refresh returns a new pair and the previous refresh token is revoked
Executed 2026-08-18. Replaying the rotated refresh token outside the grace window was rejected as expected.
Brute force protection on the sign in endpoint
A valid account and a rate limit of thirty sign in attempts per minute per address
Submit repeated sign in attempts with a wrong password beyond the configured limit
Further attempts return HTTP 429 and the account is not disclosed as existing or missing
Executed 2026-08-18. The 31st attempt returned 429; the response was identical for a known and an unknown address.
A language model provider key and a channel token saved through the settings page
Read the social credentials and llm configuration rows straight from the database
Stored values are ciphertext; no plain key is readable and the user interface only shows a masked value
Executed 2026-08-18. Both rows held ciphertext and the settings page showed only the last four characters.
Server side request forgery guard on a provider base address
The language model configuration form accepts a custom base address
Save a configuration pointing at an internal host such as the loopback interface or a private range
The value is rejected with a validation error and no outbound request is issued
Executed 2026-08-19. A public name resolving to a private address was also rejected, so the guard resolves the host before deciding.
Personal data is redacted in derived text
A customer conversation containing a phone number, an email address and an address
Trigger a summary and inspect the stored summary, the agent trace and the system log rows
Derived text keeps the meaning but the personal fields are masked; only the raw message keeps them
Executed 2026-08-19. The phone number, the email address and the street address were masked in all three stores.
Webhook payloads are authenticated before processing
The channel webhook endpoint is published and reachable
Post a forged payload without a valid signature, then post the same payload with a valid signature
The forged payload is rejected without side effects; only the signed payload creates a message row
Executed 2026-08-19. Verified on the native channel webhook and on the polling bridge entry point.
Uploaded documents are only reachable through an authorised endpoint
A knowledge document uploaded by tenant A and stored in object storage
Request the storage path directly with a tenant B session and with no session at all
Both attempts return HTTP 403 or 404 and the file content is never streamed
Executed 2026-08-19. No response payload exposed a direct storage address.
Error responses do not leak internals
An endpoint that fails because a downstream dependency is unavailable
Force the dependency down and call the endpoint, then read the response body
The client receives a generic problem response; the stack trace and connection string stay in the server log

Executed 2026-08-19. With the cache down, one endpoint returned the exception detail in the response body. The database and message queue outages behaved correctly. Fix scheduled for the next release.
Spend guard stops a runaway agent session
A tenant whose accumulated model spend is at the configured ceiling
Start a new agent session that would call a paid model
The session is refused with an explicit budget message and no paid call is issued
Not executed in this round: driving a real account up to the ceiling needs a paid provider budget that was not available. Covered indirectly by the cost tracker unit tests.
Transport is encrypted end to end
A staging deployment published behind the public domain
Walk one complete business flow through the browser and inspect every request
Every request uses transport layer security, no mixed content warning appears and strict transport security is present
Executed 2026-08-20. The websocket upgrade used by the notification and inbox hubs was also encrypted.
An administrator account with user management permission
Create one user, revoke one role and deactivate one account
Each action writes an audit row with actor, target, action and timestamp that survives a service restart
Executed 2026-08-20. All three rows were still present after the service was restarted.
Cross-tenant object access is denied via direct identifier
A document owned by tenant A whose identifier is known
HTTP 404 and no document payload is returned
Executed 2026-08-19. Tested on documents, briefs and content items; every attempt returned 404.
Role update takes effect without re-login
A sale user currently signed in
Grant an additional permission to the user role and retry the endpoint
User gains the permission on the next request without signing out
Executed 2026-08-20. Permission was applied on the next request after the role update.
A refresh token whose expiry is in the past
HTTP 401 and no new token pair is issued
Executed 2026-08-18. Token created one hour before expiry returned 401 as expected.
Send a request with X-Tenant-Id set to tenant A
Tenant from the session is used; identifier from the header is ignored or rejected
Executed 2026-08-19. Forged header had no effect on data visibility.
Rate limit is per tenant and per address
Two tenants sharing the same address
Exhaust the sign in limit for tenant A then try tenant B
Tenant B is not blocked by tenant A limit
Executed 2026-08-18. Tenant B still returned 200 after tenant A hit 429.
Session revocation invalidates all refresh tokens
A user with two active sessions
Revoke all sessions for the user then try either refresh token
Executed 2026-08-20. Both tokens were rejected after revocation.
Data export requires an explicit permission
A sale user without the export permission
HTTP 403 and no file is streamed
Executed 2026-08-20. The same call succeeded once the export permission was granted.
Backup snapshots are encrypted at rest
A nightly database backup file on the storage volume
Inspect the backup file directly on disk without the decryption key
The file content is not readable as plain SQL or plain text
Executed 2026-08-20. The backup volume uses provider-side encryption at rest; the raw file was opaque.
Security response headers are present on every page
The staging deployment behind the public domain
Fetch the main page and an API response and inspect the response headers
Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options and X-Frame-Options are present
Executed 2026-08-20. All three headers were present on both the page and the API response.
Uploaded document rejects an executable extension
The knowledge base document upload endpoint
Upload a file renamed to end in .exe
The upload is rejected with a validation error before it reaches storage
Executed 2026-08-20. The rejection happened on content-type sniffing, not just the file extension.
A read-only API key cannot reach a write endpoint by path variation
An API key issued with scope=read
Call a write endpoint using an alternate casing and trailing slash
HTTP 403 regardless of the path variation used
Executed 2026-08-20. Three path variations were tried; all were rejected consistently.
Concurrent scheduled jobs across tenants do not cross-contaminate data
Two tenants each with a due scheduled job at the same minute
Let both schedules fire at the same time and inspect the results written by each
Each job only reads and writes its own tenant's rows
Executed 2026-08-20. Ran both jobs concurrently five times; no cross-tenant row was ever written.
Agent dashboard first load with a single user
Measured 2026-08-19 on the staging build with a warm cache, median of five loads.
Inbox conversation list with ten thousand stored messages
Under one second for the first page of twenty items
Measured 2026-08-19. The endpoint is paginated; no unbounded query was observed in the server log.
Automatic reply latency from inbound message to outbound reply
Under eight seconds at the median for a short question
Measured 2026-08-19 over twenty exchanges. Provider latency accounted for about seven seconds of the total, so the target needs either a faster model or a revised figure.
Under two seconds for the retrieval step alone
Measured 2026-08-19 on the language model retrieval path that is active by default.
Content draft generation completes as a background job
Under ninety seconds for one article draft
Measured 2026-08-20. The user interface stayed responsive for the whole run.
Concurrent load on the read heavy endpoints
Fifty concurrent users with an error rate under one percent
Deferred to the next release: no load generation environment was available for this round. Recorded in the out of scope section of the test plan.
Document upload and indexing of a five megabyte file
Upload under ten seconds, indexing under two minutes
Measured 2026-08-20. Indexing ran in the background and reported progress through the job centre.
Scheduled agent batch does not block interactive traffic
Dashboard response time stays under three seconds while the batch runs
Measured 2026-08-20 while a batch of eight schedules was running; no schedule was stalled by another.
Fifty leads per page with sorting by UpdatedAt
Open /leads with page size 50 and measure first paint
Under two seconds on the staging build
Measured 2026-08-20 at 1.2 s median of five loads.
Ten thousand messages indexed for full text search
Under one second for a selective keyword
Measured 2026-08-20 at 0.4 s with a selective keyword of eight characters.
Agent tool call overhead is bounded
One agent step that calls a tool and returns
Trigger a run and measure the wall time for one tool step
Measured 2026-08-20 at 2.8 s median over ten tool steps.
Idle connection does not leak memory
Dashboard open for thirty minutes with no interaction
Observe resident memory of the browser tab and the API process
Observed 2026-08-20 over thirty minutes; memory stayed within ten percent of the start value.
Report export completes within SLA for a year of data
One year of kpi_daily rows across five channels
Under twenty seconds for a full-year CSV export
Measured 2026-08-20 with roughly 1800 daily rows in the export.
Webhook ingestion holds up under a burst
Fifty webhook calls submitted within one second
No HTTP 5xx and no dropped message under the burst
Measured 2026-08-20; all fifty payloads were queued and later ingested.
Notification delivery latency from event to unread badge
An escalation event on a conversation
Under three seconds from escalation to the unread badge updating
PDF render time for a ten-page brochure
A brochure template with ten content sections
Under twenty seconds to a ready PDF
Measured 2026-08-20; render ran as a background job without blocking the UI.
